title: Trump-bashing triggers warning for 'The View' - NewsBreak
text:
By Knewz Staff ,
10 hours ago The View ‘s liberal hosts blasted ABC’s short-lived suspension of Jimmy Kimmel’s late-night show, but Knewz.com can reveal their fiery comments are just “whistling past the graveyard.”
“They know the writing is on the wall,” a network insider revealed, confirming there’s been talk of a shift away from attacking President Donald Trump and his MAGA supporters. “If the late-night guys can be taken down, daytime isn’t untouchable. ABC doesn’t want — or need — another political controversy.”
The Kimmel scandal Whoopi Goldberg defended Jimmy Kimmel’s late-night suspension on The View after days of silence from the panel. By: MEGA ABC yanked Kimmel after he suggested far-right activist Charlie Kirk was killed by one of President Donald Trump’s MAGA supporters, despite authorities saying the alleged shooter had a leftist social media history.
The suspension sparked a media firestorm, but The View ‘s left-leaning ladies didn’t comment on Kimmel’s slap-down until the show’s top host, Whoopi Goldberg, unloaded.
“Look, did y’all really think we weren’t going to talk about Jimmy Kimmel?” she said after the show’s silence was questioned.
“When the news broke last week about Jimmy Kimmel’s suspension, we took a breath to see if Jimmy was going to say anything about it first,” she explained, adding that one of the silent days was due to a taped broadcast.
Fears The View could be next FCC Chairman Brendan Carr has been accused of targeting The View after making comments questioning its legitimacy as a news show. By: MEGA But insiders said execs are leaning on the ladies to tone it down, especially after Federal Communications Commission Chairman Brendan Carr targeted The View , saying the gabfest may no longer be protected by its equal opportunity broadcast rules.
“I think it’s worthwhile to have the FCC look into whether The View and some of the programs that you have still qualify as bona fide news programs,” Carr said on The Scott Jennings Radio Show .
Despite that, insiders said Goldberg is unconcerned. “She’s got her EGOT, she’s got her money, she’ll say what she wants. She’s untouchable and she knows it,” a source said.
The end of their careers? Insiders said The View co-host Sunny Hostin fears losing her platform as ABC cracks down on political controversy. By: MEGA But sources said co-hosts Sunny Hostin, Joy Behar and Sara Haines are facing the possibility that their hot takes could end their careers.
“Sunny, in particular, is panicked,” the source said.
“This show is her platform. Without it, she’s done. She’s realizing fast that the network won’t tolerate anything that even looks like controversy.”
Scrambling for different content Producers of The View are reportedly shifting toward lighter segments to avoid future backlash. By: @TheView/YouTube Producers, meanwhile, are working to brainstorm “softer” content — more cooking demos, celebrity fluff, even travel features.
“The marching orders are clear: No more political land mines,” one staffer claimed.
Added a veteran producer, “If they don’t adapt, they’ll be toast.”
